title: Patch: a sweep plays each card on every older catalog the build carries and folds the game back, and the four old replays that panic today open
thread:
**Issue #4382 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4382: Patch: a sweep plays each card on every older catalog the build carries and folds the game back, and the four old replays that panic today open
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A replay of a game from an older patch is replayed with that patch's own cards. Today some of those replays crash instead of opening. Examples are a game from 23 October in which someone cast Outbreak or Reoccurring Dream, and one from mid-October in which The True Sheep picked its card. Nothing checks that games from older patches still replay, so nobody noticed. After this change, a check plays every card on every older patch the game still carries and replays the result. The maintainer and the bot then learn about such a crash the day a change causes it, not when a player opens the replay. The four crashes that exist today are fixed: those replays open, or are declined cleanly when the card really worked differently back then.

## Why

**Reproduced.** I ran a throwaway test outside the repository, built against this tree. Under `jackioh_engine::with_shipped(Some(jackioh_cards::shipped_catalog(V)))`, it set up a `scenario` with the card in p1's hand and played it. For The True Sheep it also answered the Discover; for Reoccurring Dream it ended the turn; for Big D-fender it read p1's view. The output:

```
v0.4.4b outbreak: OK            v0.4.4b dream: OK
v0.4.5 outbreak: PANIC classic-039 declares no number "drawPer" (B3.4 rule 5, CardDef.params)
v0.4.5 dream: PANIC core-023 declares no number "chance" (B3.4 rule 5, CardDef.params)
v0.4.6 outbreak: OK             v0.4.6 dream: OK
v0.3.1 true sheep: PANIC meditative-088 declares no number "setCost" (B3.4 rule 5, CardDef.params)
v0.3.2b true sheep: PANIC meditative-088 declares no number "setCost" (B3.4 rule 5, CardDef.params)
v0.3.3 true sheep: OK
v0.2.5f big d-fender: PANIC core-001 declares no number "armor" (B3.4 rule 5, CardDef.params)
v0.3.0c big d-fender: OK
```

**The mechanism.**
- A carried catalog runs each card's current script unless a `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row covers it (`crates/cards/src/history.rs:98-116`).
- `build.rs`'s `def_patch` unsets the `params` an old snapshot lacked (`crates/cards/build.rs:518-530`).
- So a current script that reads a number the old definition never declared reaches `param_value`'s panic (`crates/engine/src/params.rs:208-211`).
- R3574001's fallback (`params.rs:85-92`) catches exactly this, but only for a past version's id (`card@version`). It does not cover a fold pinned to a carried catalog.
- Outbreak's and Reoccurring Dream's kept rows end at v0.4.4b, but their definitions gained `drawPer` and `chance` only in v0.4.6. The True Sheep and Big D-fender have no kept script at all.

**Who meets it.**
- The browser carries every version from v0.3.0c on (`BROWSER_CARRIED_FROM`, `crates/cards/build.rs:101`). A panic in WebAssembly is a trap the page cannot catch (`crates/wasm/core/src/lib.rs:149-150`).
- The server folds an online replay inside `catch_unwind` (`crates/server/src/actor/engine.rs:54-63`), so the replay fails to open.
- Online action logs are kept 90 days (`MATCH_ACTION_RETENTION_DAYS`, `crates/server/src/config.rs:428`). These versions shipped between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-23, so their matches are still listed under /replays.

**Why nothing caught it.**
- 207 versions are carried (`carried_versions`). Every R767000 test folds under a made-up catalog ("every Unit one Attack higher", `crates/tools/src/replay.rs:105-140`; `crates/engine/tests/rules/replay_steps.rs`; `crates/ai/tests/ai/replay_versions.rs`).
- One cross test plays three cards under v0.4.0 (`crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs:3083`).
- `patches check` only holds each carried version's definitions to its snapshot, and requires that each card has some script; `has_script_at` is true for any card with a current script.
- The fuzz corpus's `catalogVersion` is only a label: its games play on the live catalog.

**Why it must play the cards, not read the code.** A rough static scan finds a card whose script text names a number its definition lacks in 61 of the 207 carried catalogs. Most of those hits are false: the read sits on a kept script's path (Level Up's `attacks`, Second Wind's `minCost`). Only playing the card tells the two apart.

## Proposal

1. **`cargo jackioh carried [--version V] [--card id] [--json]`**, a new module, `crates/tools/src/carried.rs`. For each carried version, it visits every card **era**: a card whose definition or covering kept script differs from the version before (a card's first version included). About 2,800 definition eras exist today, 1,829 of them unlike today's.
   - Each era plays a fixed script under `with_shipped`, modelled on `fused_pairs.rs`'s: the card in p1's hand with mana to spare and a Vanilla on each side; the first play of it that `legal_actions` lists; its prompts answered by the policy; a turn ended on each side, so start- and end-of-turn hooks run; Hit Job aimed at it when it stands as a Unit, so its Death runs; then a few random-policy turns. Every step runs under `catch_unwind` with a step bound.
   - Then the log is folded as a replay pinned to that version, through the path `cargo jackioh replay` and the hosts use (`jackioh_engine::replay::fold` with `catalogVersion`), and must reach the live hash.
   - A failure names the version, the card, the stage (play, prompt, turn, death, fold) and the panic text, plus the command that plays that one era again, and exits 1.
   - A `coverage:` line counts the eras whose card the script never managed to play. It never fails.
   - No invariant monitor. Kept scripts did what today's invariants forbid (`cross/invariants.rs:3078-3083` shows I10 flagging v0.3.16's), so the check is panic, cap, refusal of a listed action, and hash.
2. **Daily:** the whole sweep as a `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` test, which super.yml's daily test step already runs. No workflow change.
3. **Per pull request:**
   - CI's bare `fuzz --seeds 200` also plays every carried era of each card the pull request changes. It uses the same `changed.rs` list `fused_pairs::play_changed` reads, prints a `changed cards (carried catalogs):` line, and is capped by a named constant.
   - A non-ignored test pins the four eras above.
   - These are the stand-ins the daily reason names.
4. **Fix today's four** with a new ruling in this issue's block. While a fold is pinned to a carried catalog, a number the carried definition never declared reads off the card's definition as the build has it, as R3574001 already says for a past version. A number no definition of the card declares still panics.
   - The fold then finishes. Where the card played the same back then, the replay opens. Where it did not, its final hash declines it, as R767000 intends ("a game it alters is refused by its final hash", `history.rs:113`).
   - Rejected alternative: a kept script per card. Big D-fender and The True Sheep have none to restore, and the next patch that turns a printed number into a declared one would open the same hole.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/carried.rs` (new), `crates/tools/src/main.rs`, `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` (the bare run's changed-card hook, beside `fused_pairs::play_changed`), `crates/tools/README.md` (its row, which `tests/acceptance.rs` holds to the CLI)
- `crates/cards/src/history.rs` (a helper listing a card's eras from `carried_versions`, `shipped_catalog` and `covering`)
- `crates/engine/src/params.rs` (`param_decl_of`), `crates/engine/src/catalog.rs` (reading whether a carried catalog is folding)
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md`, `spec/pending/<n>.md`; SPEC §9.3 and §9.2's replays, R767000, R3574001, R3538002, B3.4 rule 5
- `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, its `KEPT_SCRIPTS` section: the sweep now checks what it asks

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cargo jackioh carried` visits every era of every carried version, and its README row passes `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`.
- [ ] Before the fix, the sweep reports the four panics above: v0.2.5f `core-001` `armor`, v0.3.1 and v0.3.2b `meditative-088` `setCost`, v0.4.5 `classic-039` `drawPer`, v0.4.5 `core-023` `chance`. The pull request quotes that output.
- [ ] Each era's log is folded as a replay pinned to its version and must reach the live hash. A test with a planted carried catalog (testkit `register_shipped`), whose kept script panics or whose fold diverges, fails the sweep, naming the version, the card and the stage.
- [ ] The ruling's note, its `spec/pending/<n>.md` paragraph and its `r<n>_…` tests exist: the four cards fold under their versions, and a number no definition declares still panics. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] The whole sweep passes and runs as a `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` test whose reason names its per-PR stand-ins. Its time on four cores is recorded beside its constants.
- [ ] The bare `fuzz` run plays the carried eras of the cards a pull request changes, within a named cap, and a test shows a changed card's failing era fails that run.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.

## Size and risks

Medium to hard: about 300 to 400 lines of tooling with its tests, plus about 20 lines in the engine, a ruling and its tests. It touches no workflow.

- `shipped_catalog` builds each version on first use, re-reading the catalog (`history.rs:1225-1234`). So the full sweep pays for 207 builds; that is why it runs daily and a pull request plays only its changed cards' eras.
- The first full run may find more than these four, for example a current script making a token an old catalog lacks. Each is fixed in the same pull request or reported in it, never skipped.
- The fixed script will not reach every card; the coverage line says which it missed.
- Seen alongside, out of scope here: all eleven `KEPT_SCRIPTS` rows at v0.4.4b belong to cards that v0.4.6 ("Update Buff Priorities") claims, and v0.4.5 ("Standard deck size 25", the same day) claims none. So those rows look one version early, and v0.4.5 games with any of them fold under the newer script. The sweep cannot see that, because play and fold run the same script.

---

## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44866421662)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

A new `cargo jackioh carried` sweep plays each card **era** on every carried older catalog, folds the log back as a replay pinned to that version, and must reach the live hash. A failure names the version, card, stage and panic text, plus the command that replays that one era, and exits 1.

The four panics it finds today are fixed by a new ruling, **R4382000**. While a fold is pinned to a carried catalog, a number the carried definition never declared is read off the build's definition. A number no definition declares still panics.

The sweep runs in full as a `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` test. Per pull request, the bare `fuzz` run plays the carried eras of the changed cards, up to a named cap. A non-ignored test pins the four eras.

## Files to touch

| File | | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/params.rs` | change | `param_decl_of`: after the existing lookups, fall back to the build's definition while `catalog::folding()` is `Some` (R4382000). Update the `param_value` and `param_decl_of` doc comments. |
| `crates/cards/src/history.rs` | change | New `pub fn card_eras(id: &str) -> Vec<&'static str>`. Tests: `r4382000_…` (below) and a `card_eras` test. Add R4382000 to the `KEPT_SCRIPTS` doc comment only if it fits. |
| `crates/cards/src/lib.rs` | change | Add `card_eras` to the `pub use history::{…}` list. |
| `crates/tools/src/carried.rs` | **new** | The sweep, its `Args`, `run`, `play_changed`, constants and tests. |
| `crates/tools/src/main.rs` | change | `mod carried;`, `Command::Carried(carried::Args)` with a doc comment, and its `run` arm. |
| `crates/tools/src/replay.rs` | change | Make `fn replay_json` `pub(crate)`. No other change. |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | change | In `play_changed_cards`, after `fused_pairs::play_changed`, call `carried::play_changed(&changed.ids)` and push its error into `failed`. Add a sentence to the "Changed cards" header comment. |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | One command-table row for `carried` (same style as the `fused-pairs` row). `tests/acceptance.rs` holds the row to the clap surface: flags `--version`, `--card`, `--json`. |
| `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` | change | §3, `KEPT_SCRIPTS` paragraph (~l.223): say `cargo jackioh carried` plays and folds each era, so a kept-script gap that panics is caught. |
| `spec/rulings/R4382000.md` | **new** | Ruling note. Front matter as `R3574001.md`; `proven_in`: `crates/cards/src/history.rs`, `crates/tools/src/carried.rs`. |
| `spec/pending/4382.md` | **new** | The §11 paragraph, in the style of `spec/pending/4334.md`. |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.3, the "Append-only action log" bullet (l.42): one sentence linking `[[R4382000]]`. |
| `spec/rulings/R3574001.md`, `spec/rulings/R767000.md` | change | One closing sentence each: "See [[R4382000]]". |

**Do not touch:** `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, any workflow, the web, edge or server apps, `crates/ai`, `catalog.json`, `patches/`. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

**Governing:** SPEC §9.3 (replays), §9.2, R767000, R3538002, R3574001, R386, B3.4 rule 5, CLAUDE.md rules 3, 4, 9, 12.

## Steps

1. **Engine fix, `crates/engine/src/params.rs`, `param_decl_of`.** Keep the signature. New body:
   ```rust
   let find = |id: &str| params_of(state, id).into_iter().find(|param| param.key == key);
   if let Some(param) = find(def_id) { return Some(param); }
   let card = crate::catalog::past_card_of(def_id);
   // R3574001 (kept as is): a past version reads off its card
   if card != def_id && let Some(param) = find(card) { return Some(param); }
   // R4382000: a fold pinned to a carried catalog reads off the build's definition
   if crate::catalog::folding().is_some() {
       return crate::catalog::with_shipped(None, || find(card));
   }
   None
   ```
   `folding()` is `pub(crate)`, so no catalog.rs change is needed. `with_shipped(None, …)` makes `catalog_def` read the test override or registered catalog. A fused id resolves its ingredients the same way, and a key no definition declares stays `None`, so `param_value` still panics.
   - Callers `damage.rs:144`, `play_choices.rs:852` and `activate.rs:116` use `is_some()` or `declared_or`. For an untuned card the result is unchanged: the number was never tunable under the carried definition, so `declared_or` adds 0. A tuned number a card had in the carried definition is unaffected, because the own lookup comes first.

2. **Era helper, `crates/cards/src/history.rs`, next to `carried_versions`.**
   ```rust
   /// R4382000: the first version of each era of `id` among the carried versions, oldest first. ...
   pub fn card_eras(id: &str) -> Vec<&'static str>
   ```
   - Walk `HISTORY.versions`, skipping `CATALOG_VERSION` (as `carried_versions` does).
   - Skip a version whose `delta.absent` holds `id`, and reset the previous key there.
   - Key = `(delta.changed.get(id).copied(), covering_at(&HISTORY.order, KEPT_SCRIPTS, &delta.version, id))`.
   - Push the version when the key differs from the previous present version's, or when it is the card's first.
   - Re-export it in `crates/cards/src/lib.rs`.

3. **`crates/tools/src/carried.rs`, new.** Copy the layout of `fused_pairs.rs`. Module doc: the command, the examples, "no invariant monitor" and why (kept scripts did what today's invariants forbid, `cross/invariants.rs:3078`).
   - **Constants** (rule 9):
     - `ERA_TURNS: i32 = 4`, the random-policy turns after the fixed script.
     - `ERA_STEP_BOUND: usize = 4 * AI_PLAYOUT_STEP_CAP`, the action bound per era.
     - `CHANGED_ERAS_MAX: usize = 400`, the pull-request cap.
     - `SWEEP_MANA: i32 = 10`, used as both the `mana_bonus` and the `mana_cap`.
     - `SWEEP_DECK_COPIES: i32 = 4`.
     - `VANILLA = "core-008"`, `HIT_JOB = "core-016"`, `FILLER = "core-011"`.
     - After step 9, a comment recording the full sweep's time on four cores, beside these.
   - **`pub struct Era { version: &'static str, card: String }`** and `fn all_eras() -> Vec<Era>`:
     - It iterates `CATALOG` (sorted by id) over **non-token** cards (`!def.is_token()`) and calls `card_eras(id)` on each.
     - Tokens ride their carriers' plays. This is a decision: the alternative of dealing a token through `golden::carrier_of` was rejected because the carrier's era need not play the token.
   - **`struct EraFailure { version, card, stage: &'static str, message }`** with `report()`:
     - Output is `"carried {version} {card}: {stage}: {message}\n  reproduce: cargo jackioh carried --version {version} --card {card}"`.
     - Stages: `setup`, `play`, `prompt`, `turn`, `death`, `panic`, `step bound`, `fold`.
   - **`fn play_era(version: &str, card: &str) -> Result<Played, EraFailure>`**, where `Played` is `{ actions: usize, played: bool }`:
     - Call `register_all()` and hold `let _preview = preview_every_set();`.
     - Fetch `shipped = jackioh_engine::shipped_catalog(version)` (the engine's, so a testkit `register_shipped` plant is honoured).
     - Wrap everything in `catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(…))`, using `crate::agent::panic_message`, and run the live game inside `with_shipped(shipped, …)`.
     - **Game.** A real game, because a `scenario()` state cannot be folded.
       - `seed = format!("jackioh-carried-{version}-{card}")`.
       - p1 deck = `[card, VANILLA, FILLER]`, p2 deck = `[HIT_JOB, VANILLA, FILLER, "core-019"]`. Add a Vanilla-like filler when `card` equals one of them so the 3/4-card sizes hold (dedupe against the other ids).
       - Handicap on **both** seats: `Handicap { deck_size: <len>, mana_bonus: SWEEP_MANA, mana_cap: SWEEP_MANA, deck_copies: Some(SWEEP_DECK_COPIES), ..HUMAN_HANDICAP }`. Check the `Handicap` import path in `crates/engine/src/lib.rs`. The handicap makes each opening hand the whole deck (opening hands are 3 and 4) and gives mana to spare. `MAX_COPIES` is 1 and `MAX_MANA` is 4, which is why a handicap is needed.
       - Build with `create_game(&CreateGameOptions { seed, decks, handicaps: Some(PerPlayerOpt{…}), ..Default::default() })` then `begin_game(&created).state`. Copy the construction from `crates/ai/src/match_.rs:290-302`.
     - **Stepping.** Write `fn step(&mut self, seat, body) -> Result<(), Broke>` on a small `EraRun { state, log: Vec<Action>, policy: Rng, actions }`, copying `PairRun::step` in `fused_pairs.rs` but without the monitor and growth checks.
       - It refuses at `ERA_STEP_BOUND` (stage `step bound`).
       - It builds `Action::new(body, seat, format!("carried-{n}"))`, calls `reduce`, and on `result.error` returns stage `play` with `"reduce refused …"`.
       - On success it pushes the action to `log` and stores the new state.
     - **Fixed script.**
       1. **Mulligan.** While `mulligan_owed(&state)` is non-empty, for each owed seat step `ActionBody::Mulligan { keep: <all ids in that seat's hand> }`. Keep-all matters: with an empty library, the "draw-then-shuffle" mulligan would shrink the hand.
       2. **Play.** `settle_prompts` (policy answers while `pending.is_some()`), then p1 plays the first `legal_actions` entry that is `ActionBody::Play` whose instance is the card (as `PairRun::cast`, but any targets). If none is listed, `played = false` (coverage), and continue.
       3. **Turns.** End p1's turn and p2's turn (`ActionBody::EndTurn`), settling prompts between, so start- and end-of-turn hooks run.
       4. **Death.** If the card stands as a Unit, p2 plays `HIT_JOB` aimed at it, as `PairRun::cast` does.
       5. **Random turns.** Run the random policy (`subsystems::choose_action`, an `Rng::new(&format!("{seed}-policy"), 0)`) until `turn >= start + ERA_TURNS` or the game ends.
       - A missing action while the game is live is stage `turn` ("stall"); an unanswerable prompt is `prompt`; a failed Hit Job is `death`.
     - **Fold.** Then call `fold_check(version, card, &game_json, &hash_state(&state))`.
   - **`fn fold_check(version, card, game: &Value, live_hash: &str) -> Result<(), EraFailure>`:**
     - Insert `"catalogVersion": version` and `jackioh_cards::versions::VERSIONS_KEY: VERSIONS_SCHEME` into the game JSON. `VERSIONS_SCHEME` is in `jackioh_engine::config`.
     - Call `crate::replay::replay_json(game)` (the hosts' path) under `catch_unwind`.
     - Compare `answer["hash"]` to `live_hash`. A panic, an `Err`, or a different hash is stage `fold` naming both hashes, plus any `errors` entries.
     - The game JSON is `{seed, decks:[p1,p2], handicaps, log}`. Check the `handicaps` serde shape against `FoldArgs.handicaps` (`PerPlayerOpt`), most easily by `serde_json::to_value(&options.handicaps)`.
   - **`fn play_eras(eras: &[Era]) -> (Vec<EraFailure>, Vec<Played>)`** using `rayon` `par_iter`, as `play_pairs` does. The thread-local override (testkit) means planted-catalog tests call `play_era` directly on their own thread, not through rayon.
   - **`pub(crate) fn play_changed(changed: &[String]) -> anyhow::Result<()>`:**
     - `register_all()`, then `eras_holding(changed)`: the eras of every `all_eras()` entry whose `family(card)` (from `crate::classify::family`) is in the changed set.
     - Take at most `CHANGED_ERAS_MAX` by the `at_most` stride idea (copy it for `Vec<Era>`).
     - Empty: print `changed cards (carried catalogs): none, no changed card has an older era`.
     - Otherwise print `changed cards (carried catalogs): played {n} of {total} eras ({actions} actions), {unplayed} never played, {failed} failed`.
     - On failures print the reports and `bail!("{} of {} changed carried eras failed", …)`.
   - **`Args`** (`clap::Args`): `--version <V>`, `--card <ID>`, `--json` (all optional).
     - `--version` alone plays every era starting at that version, `--card` alone plays every era of that card, and both together play the one era. Reject an unknown version, an unknown card, or `--version`/`--card` naming a non-era with a clear `bail!`.
     - **`run`:** play the selected eras, print one `coverage: {unplayed} of {n} eras never played their card (a card the fixed script cannot play: a token-only reach, no legal Play)` line (never fails), print reports, and `bail!` when any failed (exit 1).
     - `--json` prints `{"eras", "played", "unplayed", "actions", "failures":[{version,card,stage,message}]}` instead of the prose.

4. **`crates/tools/src/main.rs`.** Add `mod carried;` (alphabetical, after `card_lists`), `Carried(carried::Args)` to `Command` with `/// Plays each card era on every older carried catalog and folds the log back as a pinned replay (#4382).`, and `Command::Carried(args) => carried::run(args),`.

5. **`crates/tools/src/replay.rs`:** `fn replay_json` becomes `pub(crate) fn replay_json`.

6. **`crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`.** After the `fused_pairs::play_changed` block in `play_changed_cards` (~l.335) add:
   ```rust
   if let Err(error) = carried::play_changed(&changed.ids) { failed.push(format!("{error:#}")); }
   ```
   Add `use crate::carried;` beside `use crate::fused_pairs;`. Extend the "Changed cards (#3113)" doc paragraph with `carried::play_changed` and `CHANGED_ERAS_MAX`.

7. **Ruling.** Write `spec/rulings/R4382000.md` and `spec/pending/4382.md`.
   - Title: "A fold pinned to a carried catalog reads a number its definition never declared off the build's definition (issue #4382)".
   - Body: the four panics (v0.2.5f `core-001` `armor`; v0.3.1 and v0.3.2b `meditative-088` `setCost`; v0.4.5 `classic-039` `drawPer` and `core-023` `chance`).
   - Body: it extends [[R3574001]] from past ids to the carried-catalog fold ([[R767000]]), and a number no definition of the card declares still panics ([[R386]]).
   - Body: where the card played the same, the replay opens; where it did not, its final hash declines it ([[R767000]]).
   - Body: rejected alternative, a kept script per card (Big D-fender and The True Sheep have none to restore, and the next patch that declares a printed number would reopen the hole). Hearthstone has no counterpart.
   - Add the §9.3 sentence and the R3574001 / R767000 cross-references.
   - `proven_in` must list both files, each holding a test whose name contains `r4382000`.

8. **Docs.** `crates/tools/README.md` row for `carried` (flags, `carried.rs`, what it plays, stages, `coverage:`, `CHANGED_ERAS_MAX`, `fuzz` also plays changed eras). Then the `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3 sentence.

9. **Before/after evidence.**
   - Do this before step 1 so the "before" output is real: after writing `carried.rs` but before editing `params.rs`, run `cargo run --release -p jackioh-tools -- carried` and keep its output.
````
